description:
## Problem (documented by the test's author and an independent reviewer, PR #2632)
The all-adapter contract test is real but incomplete:
- it drives only the `force_recreate` mode, not the default reuse-or-recreate-on-incompatibility mode;
- 12 adapters never reach the existing-database check (athena-spark, dataproc, dataproc-serverless, emr-serverless, fabric-spark, glue, quanton, synapse-spark, fabric-lakehouse, fabric_dw, motherduck, snowpark-connect) and exemptions are documented in the test; Polars was a harness fault, since fixed;
- real `fsspec`/`s3fs`/`gcsfs` removals are not observed because those libraries are not faked;
- run-owned rewrites are allowed by named allowances (BigQuery metadata `CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE`, Snowpark Connect and Snowflake load-time `TRUNCATE`, Athena staging drop, Fabric warehouse temp table);
- DuckLake sets the once-per-run flag before `_existing_lake_tables` / `_verify_run_identity` run, so if either raises the decision is still marked as made (the base class behaves the same).

## Change
Add the default reuse-or-recreate mode to the lifecycle the test drives; fake the filesystem libraries or assert on their calls; revisit each exemption and allowance and remove the ones that can now be exercised; decide the flag-ordering question for DuckLake and the base class.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- The teeth checks: removing the once-per-run guard must still fail 30+ cases.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow.
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`; then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`. Re-read every anchor before editing.
